title: The multi report prints skipped_terms, conflicts_resolved, dup_commits and the per-agent coord rows the sprint goal names
goal: bench_report prints skipped_terms, conflicts_resolved and dup_commits beside the other multi metrics and the per-agent AGENT/claims, AGENT/dedup_hits and AGENT/skipped_terms rows, so kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md shows the per-agent dedup figures token-efficiency.md cites (reviewer of SP-p46hofrg on ST-ix3lknus)

run:
import subprocess, sys
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'report', '--check'], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert r.returncode == 0, (r.stdout + r.stderr)[-300:]
t = open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
assert 'skipped_terms' in t and 'conflicts_resolved' in t and '/dedup_hits' in t, 'the report omits the per-agent and conflict figures'
